action_merges.rationale: Both actions implement the same reusable bounded recovery: after completed tool work, the next model continuation has no tool calls and no visible text, so an exact recovery nudge is sent before normal completion. The interactive/session bookkeeping differs (attempt counter versus armed-after-tool state), and each test has path-specific call-count assertions, but both use the same semantic validation oracle: observe the recovery nudge after the empty post-tool continuation. The session-loop action is the broader existing canonical.

pattern_judgments.rationale: The candidate has only one supporting workflow, from earendil-works/pi. Its mandatory action reconciles a later preflight abort for prepared parallel calls, but no independent repository supplies the same mandatory operation or an equivalent-action cluster.
missing_probes: An independent repository workflow must exercise a later preflight abort after a call is prepared and require no deferred side effect or post-execution hook plus one ordered error result for each recorded call.
Probe calls that were never prepared or recorded before the abort to determine whether placeholder results are required for them.
An untouched holdout end-task repair must apply the candidate workflow and verify the cancellation-consistent result contract.

pattern_judgments.rationale: The candidate has only one supporting workflow, from openai/codex. The implementation and validation actions coherently cover a Unix local-stdio descriptor boundary, but they are not independent repository support, and the recorded workflow explicitly leaves Windows handle inheritance unresolved.
missing_probes: An independent repository workflow must implement the same explicit-stdio-only local extension launch boundary and validate non-inheritance in both the server and a descendant while preserving transport behavior.
Probe the shared or Windows spawn path if the reusable pattern is intended to cover platforms beyond the Unix-only implementation.
An untouched holdout end-task repair must validate launch variants, transport communication, preserved launch settings, and failed-exec reporting.

pattern_judgments.rationale: Seven workflows span four repositories, but their mandatory actions do not align at the reusable semantic level: post-tool nudging and cancellation rollback, compression-default migration, deferred-resource preload budgeting, cache-warming parameter isolation, edit guards, and retry-content normalization have different mechanisms, postconditions, and validation oracles. The equivalent nudge cluster is confined to one repository, so it cannot satisfy the independent-repository requirement.
missing_probes: At least one second repository must independently implement the same mandatory budget-control action, or an explicit equivalent-action cluster, with a matching postcondition and validation oracle.
Probe whether a generic bounded-resource invariant can be stated independently of the repository-specific nudge, edit, compression, cache-warming, and deferred-preload mechanisms.

An untouched holdout end-task repair must exercise the proposed cross-repository action or cluster, including its invalid, over-budget, cancellation, or explicit-user-value preservation boundary cases.

unresolved: The proposed equivalent post-tool nudge cluster is supported only within google-gemini/gemini-cli and therefore cannot promote any pattern candidate.
